variants.name: Rows
variants.desc: Result rows scroll up a table while its eyes skim across.

variants.name: Segments
variants.desc: A segmented bar fills block by block as results come back.

variants.name: SQL
variants.desc: Lines of code type out in a little editor with a blinking cursor.

variants.name: Sort
variants.desc: Bars shuffle places until they line up shortest to tallest.

variants.name: Database
variants.desc: Sends a request to a database and catches the answer.
